4.3.1.16.2 Large Data Path in COM
The rules for the decision whether to use Large Data Path in COM are described in
System Template [8] Chapter 6.2.1 “Large Data Path in COM”.
[SWS_Rte_01376]
Upstream requirements: SRS_Rte_00246
⌈The RTE shall use Large Data Path in COM for sending/receiving arrays of bytes if
the ComIPduLargeData is set to TRUE in ComIPdu.⌋
Transmission
[SWS_Rte_01377]
Upstream requirements: SRS_Rte_00231
⌈The RTE shall use the Com_Transmit API if ComIPduLargeData is set to TRUE in
ComIPdu.⌋
In case If-API is used upon Com_Transmit, the transmit request is passed immedi-
ately to the lower layer. After return of the API the data does not need to be locked.
[SWS_Rte_01378]
Upstream requirements: SRS_Rte_00231
⌈The RTE shall use the Com_Transmit API if ComIPduType is set to NORMAL in
ComIPdu.⌋
In case TP-API is used, after Com_Transmit one or more invocations of the respective
Rte_COMCbkCopyTxData notification callback by Large Data Path in COM will occur
asynchronously. The Transmission is finalized by the invocation of Rte_COMCbkTp-
TxConfirmation notification callback as well.
During this time the data has to be available for being passed to Large Data Path in
Com.
[SWS_Rte_01379]
Upstream requirements: SRS_Rte_00246
⌈The RTE shall lock the signal buffer after it initiated a Tp Transmission (Com_Trans-
mit returned E_OK).⌋
